name: QiYi QiMeng Plus 3x3 (9.0cm)
description: The QiYi QiMeng Plus is a 9cm 3x3 that will blow your mind with its performance. Most large puzzles are made solely for the purpose of being large, but this one is built for speed. Smooth turning right out of the box, vibrant half-bright shades, corner cutting, anti-popping mechanism, this puzzle has it all.
